name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>; accurately describes purpose (apply HP damage + award kill XP). No address residue. Verified against decompile/disasm and 3 callers.
purpose: Battle damage-application primitive: applies jittered HP damage to a runtime_char and accumulates pending enemy XP; returns the actual damage dealt.
logic_summary: Reads target hp_current/hp_max from data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr[target_idx]. actual = base*9/10 + (advance_rng()%100)*base/1000 (90%..100% of base). hp_current = max(0, hp_current - actual). If portrait_id >= 0x44 (enemy): xp = enemy_entry[+9](per-level EX) * status_flags_block[0](level); if target survived (hp_after!=0) scale xp by actual/hp_max (kill keeps full xp); add xp to data_fd2_battle_pending_xp_credit. Returns actual damage. Body ends in Watcom tail-merge JMP 0x14230 (shared epilogue), source re-expresses as plain return.

params.name: target_idx
params.semantics: Index into data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr selecting the unit that takes damage. Callers pass per-target ids (fd2_calc_magic_damage forwards its target_idx; fd2_cast_status_inflict_spell and fd2_execute_special_attack_skill pass target_idx_buf[i]).
params.reason: Accurately names the array index; no address residue.

params.name: base_damage
params.semantics: Pre-jitter base damage; the 90%..100% randomized scaling is applied inside. Callers pass spell/skill raw damage (e.g. resist-scaled magic damage, AP*mult/10 - DP skill damage, or flat 10 for status spells).
params.reason: Clearly names the input damage magnitude; no address residue.

returns.semantics: Actual damage dealt (after jitter, before HP clamp). Callers clamp it against current HP and use it for the on-screen damage number and progressive animation.

comment_original_issue: Original one-line comment said 'XP for enemy kills', which understates the logic: XP is awarded on any damage to an enemy (proportionally scaled by damage when the target survives), not only on kills. Also omitted the HP-clamp and the per-level-EX*level XP basis.
notes: Disassembly (0x1c81f) confirms: HP +0x40/+0x42, base*9/10 via SHL3+ADD+IDIV10, RNG at 0x4e893, portrait_id +0x07 CMP 0x44 JL, enemy_entry+9, status_flags_block +0x21, pending_xp_credit 0x53EC8. enemy_entry +9 = EX (per-level XP) confirmed via fd2-knowledge struct enemy_entry (RA CL HP HP MP AP DP DX MV EX). Struct fields match src/include/types.h. Globals match src/include/globals.h.
